purpose: Canonical reopen-condition registry for behavioural-mechanism research. It operationalises the closed scientific baseline by stating what new evidence or external event is required before each frozen/deferred mechanism may advance, and what does not constitute a reopen trigger. Reopening authorises only the next declared evidence/identification gate; it never automatically authorises estimation, holdout inspection, causal claims, System Dynamics activation or behavioural closure.

monetary_policy_lending_rate_pass_throug.frozen_boundary: The household-housing contemporaneous delta-policy form and beta are frozen; response values are reserved from 2026-08 and no non-zero BNR policy-rate event has yet supplied prospective identifying variation.
reopen_when: Stage 1 diagnostic opens only after the first non-zero BNR policy-rate event in the reserved prospective window and official publication of the same-month ECB MIR household-housing response.

Formal confirmation opens only after at least four distinct non-zero policy-event months and at least 1.0 percentage point of cumulative absolute policy-rate movement, under the unchanged frozen contract.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: elapsed time without a non-zero policy-rate event
unchanged-rate BNR meetings
non-event months counted as identifying observations
market expectations treated as policy events
inspection of reserved MIR responses before the event and official release
refitting beta or changing the selected candidate

government_refinancing_effective_rate.frozen_boundary: The public repricing ledger has no same-boundary opening outstanding principal, realized repriced principal or matched old/new effective rates across the material MoF portfolio; the repricing parameter is not point-identifiable.
government_refinancing_effective_rate.reopen_when: An official or otherwise reproducible source supplies same-boundary opening principal plus matched refinancing/reset principal and old/new effective rates across material debt blocks, sufficient to repass the frozen ledger completeness and reconciliation gates.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: issue size substituted for opening outstanding principal
aggregate financing or refinancing need substituted for realized repriced principal
maturity share substituted for refixing share
Eurostat Maastricht apparent cost substituted for the MoF portfolio-cost boundary
synthetic allocation across currency, instrument or fixed/floating blocks

aggregate_bank_credit_response.frozen_boundary: The realised BNR BLS panel is 11/12 with 2025-Q2 missing at exact workbook precision, and the matched BNR prudential history remains unresolved under the Romanian-legal-entity-bank population boundary. Direct CBD2 substitution is rejected and the aggregate reduced form still mixes demand and supply.
reopen_when: BNR exposes the exact official 2025-Q2 BLS workbook endpoint or an exact official machine-readable BLS time-series/catalog target with matching realised-round semantics.

BNR exposes a definitionally matched prudential table history, stable machine-readable series/export/API or explicit official population/consolidation bridge satisfying the frozen prudential reopen triggers.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: rounded BLS publication text substituted for exact workbook cells
guessed BNR filenames, timestamps or internal endpoints
numerical similarity between CBD2 and BNR prudential values
third-party reproductions
synthetic aggregation of NFC and household survey signals
source completeness treated as identification of a bank-supply channel

exchange_rate_pass_through_to_inflation.frozen_boundary: The preregistered FX pass-through form failed structural selection before the untouched 2021-01..2026-06 final evaluation window could open.
reopen_when: A separately preregistered cycle is justified by genuinely new measurement evidence such as an exact Romania transaction-price import-price index.
A separately preregistered cycle is justified by new identification evidence such as an independently defensible exogenous FX-shock design or independently established regime-identification evidence.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: searching additional lags or AR orders on the same evidence cycle
adding regime dummies or asymmetry after observing the failed result
opening the untouched final evaluation to rescue the failed form
changing sign domains or external-price controls post outcome

sovereign_yield_spread_response.frozen_boundary: The fiscal-augmented common-market AR candidate failed predictive and sign-consistency gates before the untouched 2023-Q1..2026-Q1 final evaluation window opened.
sovereign_yield_spread_response.reopen_when: A separately preregistered cycle is justified by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence, such as an exact retained domestic policy-rate vintage or an independently justified issuance/refinancing observable.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: post-result lag search on the same data
adding or dropping fiscal variables after observing the failed selection
changing coefficient sign assumptions post outcome
opening the final evaluation window to choose a replacement form

household_consumption_response.frozen_boundary: Housing-loan DSTI levels are observed, but the borrower population does not align with aggregate S1M consumption and no official representativeness bridge has been identified.
reopen_when: An observed Romania aggregate household debt-service burden aligned to S1M consumption becomes available.
An independently observed representativeness bridge from housing-loan borrowers to the aggregate S1M consumption population becomes available.
An observed housing-borrower consumption/income target becomes available under a separately preregistered borrower-specific mechanism.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: owner-occupier status used as a mortgage-borrower proxy
cross-country representativeness transfer
synthetic borrower weights
fit-selected mortgage versus consumer-credit rates
merging new-loan and outstanding-loan DSTI

corporate_investment_response.frozen_boundary: The preregistered core and support-augmented investment-rate forms failed structural selection before the untouched 2024-Q1..2026-Q1 final evaluation window opened.
corporate_investment_response.reopen_when: A separately preregistered cycle is justified by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence that changes the admissible source/design boundary rather than merely respecifying the failed form.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: changing lags on the same evidence cycle
changing coefficient signs or predictor set post outcome
changing target or financing-rate family after failed selection
adding interactions or regimes post outcome
opening the final evaluation window to rescue the failed form

credit_risk_npl_response.frozen_boundary: The exact aggregate NPL target has no matched aggregate debt-service burden; the mortgage-specific alternative lacks an exact machine-readable mortgage NPL history and a preregistered target/population/activity boundary.
reopen_when: Retain an aggregate Romania debt-service burden aligned to the exact aggregate NPL target and freeze the activity/output boundary.

Retain exact machine-readable mortgage NPL plus housing-loan burden histories, reconcile population/coverage/weighting, freeze an activity/output observable and preregister a mortgage-specific target/form.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: DTI-O substituted for debt-service burden
digitising BNR mortgage NPL charts
choosing aggregate versus mortgage target after model fit
assuming aggregate DSTI from housing-loan DSTI
ignoring NPL recognition, cure, write-off, sale or reporting breaks

fiscal_primary_balance_reaction.frozen_boundary: The preregistered annual lagged-state fiscal-reaction form failed structural selection before the untouched 2018-2024 final evaluation window opened.
fiscal_primary_balance_reaction.reopen_when: A separately preregistered cycle is justified by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence, such as a cyclically adjusted primary-balance vintage, longer real-time historical vintages or an independently justified regime/identification design.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: respecifying the annual form on the same evidence cycle
changing output-gap sign/domain assumptions after the failed result
opening the untouched final evaluation to choose a replacement form
using later revised information as if available in real time

monetary_policy_reaction_function.frozen_boundary: Quantitative private inflation expectations and the quarterly BNR GDP-gap concept are confirmed, but reproducible machine-readable formation-date expectations and real-time GDP-gap vintage histories are not retained.
reopen_when: BNR exposes a machine-readable quantitative analyst-expectations history indexed by survey formation date or an official reproducible mapping to formation dates.
BNR exposes machine-readable quarterly GDP-gap vintages with report/decision information cutoffs and revision timing.
Equivalent stable official API/export/data-annex mappings satisfy the same time semantics.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: digitising analyst-expectations or GDP-gap charts
treating target-horizon-shifted chart coordinates as formation dates
backfilling later revised GDP-gap paths into earlier policy decisions
substituting qualitative consumer balances, BNR staff forecasts or annual AMECO gaps
guessing hidden BNR database endpoints

external_fx_refinancing_feedback.frozen_boundary: Available official sources expose only marginal sector, currency, maturity/refinancing or S13 risk information; the joint sector × currency × residual-maturity/refinancing exposure and sector hedging needed to close the chain are unidentified.
external_fx_refinancing_feedback.reopen_when: A new official source identifies joint sector × currency × residual-maturity/refinancing exposure, or sector-specific hedging information sufficient to close the required exposure boundary.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: recombining existing marginal ECB BPS, BNR external-debt and MoF risk tables
assuming independence across sector, currency and residual maturity
using central-bank reserve-template residual maturity for broader external-debt sectors
inventing sector hedging ratios
